This writes DSH\'s startup bundle list, so it takes effect after DSH restarts. Until then the plugin keeps running in its previous state.
Written to the startup bundle list. It takes effect after DSH restarts.
Disabling removes whatever this plugin provides. The change is written to the plugin list on your computer, with a backup of the original file. It takes effect after DSH restarts.
Enabling restores whatever this plugin provides. The change is written to the plugin list on your computer, with a backup of the original file. It takes effect after DSH restarts.

Off uses the native screen. On renders the chat page with the built-in web view, so Markdown, code blocks and cards look closer to the desktop.
Still a trial: streaming was wired up recently, and small differences from the native version remain. Switch it off any time.
Blocks the system pushes in every turn: runtime context, time context, background job notices. Hidden by default — they put a row of collapsed blocks between every message. Turn on when debugging.
When on, each assistant message gets a small grey line explaining why a card did not render as a component.
Tap the grey line to expand it, long-press to copy. If you see a warning sign or “fences seen but not recognised”, send a screenshot.
